title: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings

suppliers.sup:70110: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: HN 50-200 volute casings – proposal for a balanced adjustment
messages.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

thank you for your offer and for many years of reliable partnership, including your support in 2022. We want a solution that keeps your foundry healthy.

PPI-D351 fell from 140.5 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-11) to 123.7 (idx:PPI-D351@2026-04), a change of -11.96 %.
Our should-cost cost:310010 puts the unit cost at EUR 132.64, clearly below the requested price.
Our forecast fc:310010@2026-09 records a 10.1 % change for this casing.

Please see the three attached alternatives for 8,150 pcs per year over 12 months. You can choose the timing or payment terms that suit your cash flow best. Could you also tell us your earliest possible lead time, and whether a cheaper casting variant is possible?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: HN 50-200 volute casings – proposal for a balanced adjustment
messages.body:
Guten Tag,
Thank you for your letter - it is always good to hear from you, and I answer it myself, as I do for all the customers we have known for a long time.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €133.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 November 2026.
A few words from the foundry on this.
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We did not know that - a fair point.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains.
I have asked our engineering and production colleagues to address your questions regarding lead times and potential casting variants.
Building on your third alternative for a November 2026 start with 30-day payment terms, we are prepared to offer a revised price of €133.10 per unit.
Our Lieferzeit is 42 days.
We have worked together for many years, and I am confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have between our two houses.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Foundry Engineer: We build strictly according to your drawing and do not propose any design changes.

messages.subject: HN 50-200 volute casings - balanced terms for 2027
messages.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

thank you for your quick and personal reply, and for taking our data into account. We value our partnership and want your foundry on a sound footing.

PPI-D351 also fell from 137.0 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08) to 131.9 (idx:PPI-D351@2026-08), a change of -3.72 %.

We accept your unit price level. We ask for movement on timing and payment instead. The attached alternatives cover 8,150 pcs per year over 12 months. Please choose the one that best suits your cash planning and confirm it as your standing offer.

Could you also tell us your earliest possible lead time?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: HN 50-200 volute casings - balanced terms for 2027
messages.body:
Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €133.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, valid from 1 November 2026.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
We have already taken that index change data into account.
Building on your second alternative, we can accommodate the 1 January 2027 start date and 60-day payment terms at a unit price of €133.30.
To answer your question, our earliest possible lead time remains 42 days.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 60 days net and valid from 1 January 2027: €133.30 per unit.
Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.
Our Lieferzeit is 42 days.
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: HN 50-200 volute casings: confirming your price with timing and payment alignment
messages.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

thank you for your constructive offers. We accept your unit price level. To answer your question: the index data came from the published PPI-D351 series we cited earlier.

Our scorecard sc:70110@2026Q3 records an on-time delivery rate of 85.2 %, rated amber.

Given this, we ask that you combine your price with 90-day payment terms and a later start date. Both attached alternatives cover exactly 8,150 pcs per year over 12 months at your quoted unit price. Please confirm the first alternative as your standing offer. If that is not possible, please confirm the second.

We would also welcome any measures that improve delivery reliability.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: HN 50-200 volute casings: confirming your price with timing and payment alignment
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

As to the delivery record data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point. We have verified the delivery record data you cited; it holds and we have taken it into account. I have personally asked our production team to review our scheduling to ensure our delivery reliability meets your expectations. 

We can accept your terms and await your order. For our Angebot, we quote a price of €133.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, valid from 1 January 2027. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days. Our offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
